name: release-0-28-ops-list-blueprints-gemini-flash-latest
description: A ggui_ops_list_blueprints result as @ggui-ai/* 0.28.0 (a734373b5) would emit it for a generation-minted row whose run route is `gemini/gemini-flash-latest`: SYNTHESISED, not captured — `release-14-ops-list-blueprints.json` (the tag-14 capture) with exactly two edits, `source.model` set to that id and `blueprintId` renamed to say so; the id is one 0.28.0's `MODELS.google` admitted and which left the allowlist in 0.29 (ggui#1291; at the vendor it is a `-latest` alias that the vendor says is hot-swapped with every release, with no stated target). Between tag 14 and 0.28.0 the row schema gained one optional member this row does not carry (`clonedFrom`), nothing else. Today's opsListBlueprintsOutputSchema MUST accept the result and the parsed row MUST carry `source.model` as sent: a 0.29 reader refusing it would drop the stored row at its store's read door and refuse a 0.28 server's `ggui_ops_*` blueprint outputs naming `model` (VERSION-POLICY §3.6). The tolerance expires in 0.30, one release after the drop; this case leaves with it.
